name: christerhagen
title: Christer Hagen
description: Read-only MCP access to christerhagen.com: identity facts, the companies Christer Hagen founded and backed, his essays, and full-text search across every page.

authentication.description: No authentication. Everything this server exposes is already public on the site.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search across every page, ranked by match count.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch one page as markdown by its path.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every page URL, English and Norwegian.

tools.name: list_ventures
tools.description: Companies founded vs companies only backed, with role, stage, year and status.

tools.name: list_writing
tools.description: Essays and notes, with year, reading time and excerpt.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Canonical identity facts, including the Wikidata entity.
